content.title: Review and expand portfolio alerts
content.description: An investment professional scans portfolio and market-relevant alerts by severity, expands a single alert inline to inspect more detail, and shifts focus between alerts without turning the list into a modal interaction or leaving more than one alert expanded at once.
content.summary: Review alert feed and expand one alert at a time
content.value: Keeps the user aware of urgent events and lets them inspect one actionable alert at a time.
criteria: The alerts panel includes Technology concentration above target, NVDA crossed 52-week high, Portfolio volatility increased 7.2%, Fed rate decision tomorrow, and Cash position below tactical minimum.
Alert severities are critical, warning, and info.
Each alert includes severity, title, timestamp, and a dismiss control where applicable.
Clicking an alert expands it inline, only one alert may be expanded at once, and opening another collapses the previous one.
The alert list must not become a modal.
